codegen.//: No `command` on purpose, so this falls through to the package.json script. A bare `lunora codegen` here would skip the post-codegen check that follows it — the regression guard in `scripts/check-generated.mjs` for the `.pnpm` store-path import codegen once emitted. (It also used to be needed because codegen took several passes to converge from a cold `_generated/`; that is fixed, one pass reproduces it byte-for-byte.)

dev.//: `dependsOn: codegen` so a checkout with no (or a stale) `_generated/` converges BEFORE the worker boots, rather than serving a half-inferred API and failing somewhere unrelated. It is cached on the sources, so a warm start pays nothing and a cold one pays ~11s.
